saw_lines: Endurance athletes pick gels by taste and gut tolerance, then reorder the one that did not upset them on race day.
So the sale is decided in the first line, where a new athlete weighs the offer and the proof before clicking.
Your site shows over 2,700 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put the review count on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows over 2,700 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so cold buyers get no trust signal. Put the review count on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

Your site offers new customers WELCOME10 for 10% off, yet 0 of 27 ads mention it, so new buyers never see the code before they click. Put WELCOME10 in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Only 2 of 27 ads are creator posts pushed from your brand page, so a creator’s trust stays on their account, not with buyers who see your ads. Whitelist those two from the creator account and cut three variations.
11 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product on screen, so a buyer has to search the range again. Point each of those ads to the product or brand page its own copy names.
